name: personal-assistant
description: GK — an end-to-end personal assistant (React + Node.js + MongoDB + Python) with a pluggable bot hub

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && pip install -r ai-service/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,ai -c magenta,cyan,yellow "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev" "cd ai-service && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && cd ai-service && python -m pytest -q
